title: Nadler Theorem on Generalized Metric Spaces with Weighted Graphs
summary: We introduce a generalized metric space endowed with a weighted graph and establish sufficient conditions for the existence of fixed points for set-valued mappings that satisfy a contractive condition only along the links of the graph. To demonstrate the applicability and significance of our results, several illustrative examples are presented. As an application, we establish the solvability of a class of integral problems involving set-valued data.
